title: Laredo ISD Police Hold First Donut Dash 5K to Collect Toys for Kids
excerpt: Laredo ISD police held their first Donut Dash 5K on Saturday, Nov. 21, trading race entry for a new toy to benefit children ages 5 to 18 this Christmas.
content:
Laredo ISD police held their first Donut Dash 5K on Saturday, Nov. 21, trading race entry for a new toy to benefit children this Christmas, according to KGNS.

There was no monetary entry fee. Instead, organizers asked participants to bring a new toy valued at $25 or more, with donations benefiting children ages 5 to 18, both boys and girls.

Check-in began at 7 a.m., with the race starting at 8 a.m. at the Shirley Field parking lot. Runners and walkers were welcome to take part at their own pace, and donuts waited for finishers, LISD Police Chief Doreen Hale told KGNS.

The toy drive ties into the department's Feliz Navidad Christmas Express, an initiative in which officers deliver toys to children during the Christmas season.

Source: KGNS, Nov. 18 and Nov. 21, 2026.
